title: Farol Protocol v0.3 — action/invoke
description: Request and response envelopes for the action/invoke method. See protocol/SPEC.md §5.3 for the normative round-trip and §7.2 for its dedicated timeout budget (RPC_TIMEOUT_ACTION, distinct from RPC_TIMEOUT_CONTROL used by handshake/hello and widget/get). References ActionTarget from handshake.schema.json and GitRepository/VpnStatusItem from widget.schema.json. Evolved from v0.2 (protocol/schema/v0.2/action.schema.json, retained as-is): ActionInvokeResult, previously a fixed object shape carrying only repo, is now a oneOf discriminated by which single property is present - repo (unchanged, git-local's fetch action) or the new vpn_status (research.md D2/D4-D5, data-model.md §1.5), returned by the openfortivpn-gui reference plugin's vpn.connect/vpn.disconnect actions. The wire already emitted by git-local ({"repo": {...}}) keeps validating against the first branch unchanged - this is an additive change.

action_id.description: Must match the `id` of an ActionDeclaration the plugin previously declared (in the handshake result and/or a widget/get response) for the given target, with enabled=true.

target.description: MUST be echoed back verbatim from the target of the ActionDeclaration that motivated this invocation - the core MUST NOT reconstruct a target on its own.

ActionInvokeResult.title: ActionInvokeResult
ActionInvokeResult.description: Result of a successful action invocation. Discriminated by which single property is present - new in v0.3 (research.md D2/D4-D5, data-model.md §1.5); v0.2 (protocol/schema/v0.2/action.schema.json, retained as-is) had a single fixed object shape carrying only repo. For the git-local reference plugin's git.fetch action, repo is the post-fetch repository state. For the openfortivpn-gui reference plugin's vpn.connect/vpn.disconnect actions, vpn_status is the post-action VpnStatusItem - same pattern as git.fetch, the core replaces the corresponding widget's data with this value directly, without an additional widget/get call (FR-018-equivalent of this feature). The wire already emitted by git-local ({"repo": {...}}) keeps validating against the first branch, unchanged.

repo.description: Updated state of the target repository after the action ran.

oneOf.title: ActionInvokeResultVpnStatus
oneOf.description: New in v0.3 (research.md D2/D4-D5, data-model.md §1.5) - returned by vpn.connect/vpn.disconnect.

vpn_status.description: Updated VPN connection status after the action ran.

ActionInvokeResponseError.title: ActionInvokeResponseError
ActionInvokeResponseError.description: E.g. code -32001 / reason "fetch_failed" when the underlying action execution failed, or code -32002 / reason "action_timeout" synthesized by the core when RPC_TIMEOUT_ACTION elapses. MUST NOT cause the plugin process to exit (protocol/SPEC.md §8.3) - the plugin keeps responding to subsequent requests. Never marks the plugin connection unavailable by itself.
